IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx and tail latency observed for /v1/chat generate on model redwood-medium-q4-canary in us-east-2. 1m error rate = 9.1%, p99 latency doubled.

Priya: I'm taking pager. Can someone grab the canary vs stable diffs and recent deploys? @Luca @Anika

Luca: oncall here. Looking at traces now. Early sign: tokenization mismatch warnings in the canary serving logs + elevated decode errors. Pulling sample traces.

Anika: infra showing increased kernel timeout retries on canary GPUs starting 2420011100. No node OOMs, but connection retries to model shards increased.

Ben: CS reports 2 customers with elevated error rates; one reported failing batches during peak. Not full outage but noticeable SLA degradation.

CSBot: Customer impact: ~220 failing requests across 4 customers between 2420011120 and 2420011180, with retry loops observed. Recorded that one paying customer escalated to support.

Priya: Root cause hypothesis list: A) new quantization path regression in canary, B) experimental kernel fusion flag interacting with Q4 layout, C) autoscaler mis-routing. Need diffs and deploy history.

DeployBot: Canary group "q4-canary-us-east-2" deploy history:
- 2420011085: v2026-03-20-q4-canary (flags: --fuse-attn-experimental, --kv-cache-async)
- 2419900000: v2026-03-10-q4 (stable)

Luca: here's a small log excerpt from the canary nodes:

Anika: ```
2026-03-20T02:18:05Z svc infer redwood-medium-q4-canary req=xyz tokenization_warn=1 latency_ms=1450
2026-03-20T02:18:06Z kernel: fused-attn selected, retry_count=3
2026-03-20T02:18:07Z svc infer redwood-medium-q4-stable req=xyza latency_ms=420
```

Luca: infra traces show kernel selection switching to fused-attn on canary and retries spiking.

Priya: Given customer impact and tight correlation with deploy, recommend immediate mitigation: 1) pin affected tenants to stable version, 2) scale down canary or drain new sessions, 3) rollback canary to stable. Which to do first?

Anika: I can pin routes quickly. Pinning is less disruptive. After pinning, drain canary nodes to stop new traffic. Rollback can follow.

Ben: Agree. Also prepare customer comms: "We've pinned your traffic to a stable runtime and are rolling back the experimental canary."

Anika: pin command (running):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pins -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","model":"redwood-medium-q4","version":"v2026-03-10-q4"}'
```

Luca: smoke test for acme-corp after pin: 1/1 success, latency 430ms. Good.

Anika: Initiating drain on canary nodes in us-east-2: `kubectl label node group=q4-canary unschedulable=true` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

DeployBot: Rollback initiated for q4-canary-us-east-2 -> v2026-03-10-q4. Estimated rollback completion 3m per AZ.

CSBot: Notifying affected customers now. Message sent at 2420011325.

Luca: Monitoring shows error rate for pinned tenants drop to baseline after pin. Canary error rate decreasing as instances roll back.

Anika: kernel retries decreased post-rollback. p99 back to normal. No new restarts.

Priya: Good. Next: in-incident RCA actions - capture full timeline, export canary and stable logs, run diffs on kernel selection and tokenization module, attempt unit repro with fused-attn flag. Luca + Anika to own. Ben to own customer comms and severity update. I'll file an RCA ticket and assign follow-ups.

Ben: Filing ticket: INC-2026-2420011222-RCA. Will include timeline, logs, diffs, and proposed hotfix (disable fused-attn by default for q4).

Anika: Checklist for ticket: [ ] collect full KV-cache traces, [ ] export kernel selection logs, [ ] replay failing requests locally with and without --fuse-attn-experimental, [ ] run regression evals on held prompt set, [ ] add tokenization unit tests for boundary cases.

Luca: Infra checklist: [ ] snapshot canary node images, [ ] collect GPU kernel debug logs, [ ] verify autoscaler routing during the window.

Priya: Closing live pager — mitigation succeeded, customers pinned and canary rolled back. We'll monitor for 1 hour. If any regression, re-pager. Thank you team. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Pager closed by Priya at 2420011580.
